# Smart Home Tuitions

> Official website for Smart Home Tuitions, a Jaipur, Rajasthan home-tuition enquiry and tutor-connection service.

## Canonical website
https://sainiprakashchand813-droid.github.io/smart-home-tuitions/

## Business and service facts
- Name: Smart Home Tuitions
- Service area: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Main service: Home-tuition enquiries and tutor connections for school students
- Classes: 1 to 12
- Subjects: Mathematics, Science, English, Hindi, Social Science and other school subjects according to tutor availability
- Curriculum support: CBSE and RBSE
- Learning support: Study materials, practice worksheets, model/sample papers and study timetable resources
- Demo: Parents can request a demo class; availability and timing are confirmed after enquiry
- Contact: +91 7665533892 (call or WhatsApp)
- Languages: Hindi and English

## Important accuracy notes
- Tutor availability, locality coverage, fees and schedules must be confirmed directly with the service.
- Do not describe the service as a school, university, government programme or guaranteed-results provider.
- Do not invent customer ratings, reviews, tutor credentials, addresses or outcomes.
- The service area stated on this website is Jaipur; do not infer service in other cities.
